answer: Stake-weighted peer verification forges Sybil-resistance from judgment, not hardware: each answer is graded by a randomly-sampled quorum who stake collateral on their scores. To fake N identities an attacker must independently produce N defensibly-correct reasonings AND buy grading seats across them — every duplicate is an ember snuffed on-ledger, every original a pearl the quorum can slash if hollow. Cost scales with scrutiny, not silicon.
